LanguageData.HD_Production_RequiredFacilitiesDesc: Facilities must be linked to the production workbench. Higher-tier lathes and mills can replace earlier models. Armor production accepts a line-shaft hydraulic press or a 1970s hydraulic press; the press must be powered, switched on, and in working order. Unpowered, disconnected or removed presses stop the production job.
LanguageData.HD_Production_LateGunTools: Turret lathe + milling machine (or higher tiers)
